SELECT anon_1.cid, count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT course_modules.course_id AS cid, module_progress.enrollment_id AS eid, count(*) AS c 
FROM module_progress JOIN course_modules ON course_modules.id = module_progress.module_id JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.id = module_progress.enrollment_id 
WHERE course_modules.published IS true AND course_modules.deleted_at IS NULL AND course_modules.course_id IN (%(course_id_1_1)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_2)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_3)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_4)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_5)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_6)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_7)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_8)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_9)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_10)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_11)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_12)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_13)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_14)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_15)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_16)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_17)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_18)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_19)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_20)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_21)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_22)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_23)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_24)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_25)s::UUID) AND module_progress.state = %(state_1)s AND enrollments.course_id IN (%(course_id_2_1)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_2)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_3)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_4)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_5)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_6)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_7)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_8)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_9)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_10)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_11)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_12)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_13)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_14)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_15)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_16)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_17)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_18)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_19)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_20)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_21)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_22)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_23)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_24)s::UUID, %(course_id_2_25)s::UUID) AND enrollments.role = %(role_1)s AND enrollments.state = %(state_2)s AND enrollments.is_test_student IS false GROUP BY course_modules.course_id, module_progress.enrollment_id) AS anon_1 JOIN (SELECT course_modules.course_id AS cid, count(*) AS n 
FROM course_modules 
WHERE course_modules.published IS true AND course_modules.deleted_at IS NULL AND course_modules.course_id IN (%(course_id_1_1)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_2)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_3)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_4)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_5)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_6)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_7)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_8)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_9)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_10)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_11)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_12)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_13)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_14)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_15)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_16)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_17)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_18)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_19)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_20)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_21)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_22)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_23)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_24)s::UUID, %(course_id_1_25)s::UUID) GROUP BY course_modules.course_id) AS anon_2 ON anon_2.cid = anon_1.cid 
WHERE anon_1.c = anon_2.n GROUP BY anon_1.cid

SELECT submissions.course_id AS course_id, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (submissions.state = %(state_1)s) THEN %(param_1)s ELSE %(param_2)s END), %(coalesce_1)s) AS graded, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (submissions.state = %(state_2)s) THEN %(param_3)s ELSE %(param_4)s END), %(coalesce_2)s) AS pending_review, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (submissions.state = %(state_3)s) THEN %(param_5)s ELSE %(param_6)s END), %(coalesce_3)s) AS excused, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (submissions.state IN (%(state_4_1)s, %(state_4_2)s, %(state_4_3)s) AND CASE WHEN (assignments.kind = %(kind_1)s) THEN assessments.due_at ELSE assignments.due_at END < %(param_7)s) THEN %(param_8)s ELSE %(param_9)s END), %(coalesce_4)s) AS due_filled 
FROM submissions JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.id = submissions.enrollment_id JOIN assignments ON assignments.id = submissions.assignment_id LEFT OUTER JOIN assessments ON assessments.id = assignments.assessment_id

FROM (SELECT submissions.course_id AS cid, submissions.enrollment_id AS eid, sum(submissions.effective_points) AS pts, sum(submissions.points_possible) AS poss 
FROM submissions JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.id = submissions.enrollment_id JOIN assignments ON assignments.id = submissions.assignment_id LEFT OUTER JOIN assessments ON assessments.id = assignments.assessment_id
